description: Source-grounded research pipeline inspired by NotebookLM. Collect verbatim source extracts into a temporary workspace, then answer questions and create deliverables grounded in those sources. Two grounding modes: strict (vault-only) and augmented (vault + labeled [background] knowledge). Trigger when the user asks to research a topic from sources, wants NotebookLM-style grounded answers, asks to build a resource vault, or says "notebooklm mode".
